meta.notes: A merchant: msm:trader opens the villager trading screen when a player uses it with an empty hand. Its first level offers its own wares from msm_examples:spice_trader/wares (8 minecraft:cocoa_beans for 1 emerald, 8 minecraft:sugar for 1 emerald); trading earns it experience, which unlocks the wandering trader's common wares (minecraft:wandering_trader/common) and then its rare ones (minecraft:wandering_trader/uncommon). Its trades restock twice a day, without a workstation. It does not trade while it is a baby, hurt and fleeing, or ridden, and keeps its offers when the world is saved. It spawns now and then on its own in plains and meadows (rule animal: on grass in daylight). msm:animated_model names the model, animation set and texture with renderer auto: GeckoLib draws it where the target has GeckoLib, the runtime's own renderer elsewhere. Export the Fabric mod jar to try it in game.
